learn.title: Learn
learn.gradingLenientDesc: The general meaning is enough: typos, rewording and synonyms listed on the card are accepted.
learn.gradingMediumDesc: An exact match is needed, but spelling mistakes (accents, one missing or wrong letter) are accepted.
learn.gradingStrictDesc: An exact match is needed; only small style differences (capitals, punctuation, text in brackets) are accepted.
learn.retypeDesc: After a wrong written answer you have to type the correct one.
learn.restartConfirm: Restart? Your Learn progress in this set will be reset.
learn.atLeastOne: At least one option has to stay on.
learn.retypePrompt: Type the correct answer to continue
learn.retypeWrong: That doesn't match yet. Try again.
learn.flipCard: Flip the card and rate yourself
learn.finishedText: You learned {count} cards from this set.

match.explainTerm: Pick the term first, then its definition.

match.atLeastOne: At least one of them has to stay on.

match.tileHint: Tap two tiles that belong together, or drag one onto the other.

settings.deleteAccountText: Your account and all your data (progress, stars, tests, profile picture) will be deleted permanently. This can't be undone.
settings.guestAccount: You're using Flashly as a guest. Log in or sign up to keep your progress on every device.
settings.noGroups: You haven't opened any groups yet.
settings.addGroupHint: Choose the group and enter its password.
settings.volumeDesc: Applies to sound effects and reading aloud.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: Flashly only stores the data it needs to work. No tracking, no analytics, no ads, and no scripts loaded from third parties.
privacy.whatTitle: What we store if you have an account
privacy.whatList: Your username and a hash of your password (never the password itself). Your profile picture, if you upload one. Your settings, the groups you opened, your progress per card, your starred cards, your test results and your best Match times.
privacy.guestText: Your progress stays on your own device (in the browser's storage). The groups you opened are remembered on this device by a signed cookie.
privacy.cookiesText: We only use cookies needed for the app to work: login, guest access, language and theme. They don't require consent and are never used for tracking.
privacy.deleteText: You can delete your account at any time in Settings. All your data is then deleted permanently.
privacy.contactText: The app is run by its administrator. If you have questions about your data, contact them.

offline.title: No internet connection
